name: Anglesey and Alverstoke
notes: Made on 21 March 2024, when the council merged, amended and extended the former Alverstoke and Anglesey conservation areas (council list No. 1, 'Amended and extended 2024'). The PDP holds only the two former areas (entities 44003517 and 44003518), which should be ended.
